items.line: Elon Musk jokes about "Singularity dot Com", a dating site for digital superintelligences.
DiscussingFilm says GTA 6 earned $3.79 billion in its first day and calls it the biggest entertainment launch of all time. IGN carries the same figure and credits Rockstar Games. Not checked here.
Dexerto says a Discord user built an AI "girlfriend" bot you can talk to in a voice call, and that it giggles before answering in the demo. It says viewers are asking when they can try it.

Eric Daugherty says the Nasdaq plunged and wiped out its 2026 gains, and quotes President Trump saying "We've lost $4 TRILLION since the election." Neither the market move nor the figure is checked here.
DiscussingFilm shares a first look at a Star Wars and Marvel crossover comic in which Spider-Man meets Luke Skywalker, with the line "I'm Peter Parker, I'm here to rescue you."
Unusual Whales says Bloomberg reports that CrowdStrike is in talks to acquire Zscaler. Not checked here.
Fox News shares Christian artist Phil Wickham at its All-American Christmas Tree Lighting, saying "the best news you could ever hear is that God loves you."
Formula 1 posts a video from the Las Vegas Grand Prix weekend, captioned "Whoa! George ⚔️ Max". The post does not say what happens in it, so that is not checked here.
Brian Greene shares a video summary of reports that AI may have solved the Riemann Hypothesis. Not checked here.
Aaron Rupar posts a short video of President Trump talking about Democratic majorities. Rupar quotes him as saying "We could end up with great healthcare in our country." Not checked here.
CultureCrave says "Grand Theft Auto 6" has been review-bombed by users on Metacritic and shows a 4.9 rating. Not checked here.

Ed Krassenstein posts a 28-second clip of President Trump with Stephen Miller at the White House podium. He says Trump seemingly endorsed Miller for president over JD Vance and Marco Rubio. Polymarket describes the same exchange as Trump asking Miller if he would like to run in 2028. Not checked here.

Fox News reports that the FBI’s National Crime Information Center, a database used for background checks and for sharing warrant information among law enforcement agencies, has been hacked. The post says it is unclear what was taken. Not checked here.
Nature Unedited posts a video of a whale and says the discomfort the whale had endured for years disappeared in 30 seconds. What the video shows is not checked here.
Watcher Guru says crypto keeps falling: Bitcoin under $56,000, Ether under $1,550, and $650,000,000 in leveraged positions liquidated in the past hour. Not checked here.
TMZ says Macaulay Culkin is returning as Kevin McCallister in a "Home Alone" sequel. Not checked here.
The NBA says James Harden scored 51 points, the most he has scored as a Cavalier, as Cleveland moved to 2-1 in Emirates NBA Cup group play.
Fabrizio Romano says Désiré Doué left the pitch in tears after a serious injury and was taken off at once. The post has a photo. The injury is not checked here.

Neuralink posts a 2-minute video titled "Playing GTA VI with a Neuralink". The post does not say who is playing or how the controls work. Elon Musk quote-posts it with "Playing GTA VI with Telepathy".
Kpop Charts, a fan chart account, says CORTIS won Song of the Year (Daesang) with "REDRED" at the 2026 MAMA Awards. Not checked here.

PopCrave says journalist Andrew Ross Sorkin is facing criticism for asking Hailey Bieber why she thought she could sell her brand Rhode for $1 billion. The post carries a 37-second video. The criticism is PopCrave's description. Not checked here.
The account "caseoh out of context" posts a clip it says shows the streamer Caseoh giving Lucia another makeover while singing "Hot to Go". I could not see the clip.
The account TheGameVerse posts an 11-second video it calls the funniest GTA 6 clip it has seen so far. The clip is not described in the record, so what it shows is not checked here.

Kraken's support account says that from about 20:00 UTC on Nov 20, heavy selling pushed prices of its CAD pairs well below other markets. It says the platform processed every order correctly, its security teams found no sign of a breach, and executed trades stand. Not checked here.
Popstonox says Donald Trump shared Abdul El-Sayed's Medicare for All proposal on Truth Social, and that El-Sayed had suggested renaming it "TrumpCare for All". Not checked here.
JT News posts a 24-second video it says shows the singer JT performing "Okay" at the GTA VI launch party.
Adam Schefter reports that the New England Patriots are close to the limit of players they can designate to return from injured reserve, so Drake Maye and AJ Brown may not be placed there.
Radec posts a 29-second video, credited to Reddit user MelloYello917, that he says shows the best way to get money in GTA 6. The post does not describe the video. Not checked here.
The account Nancy Pelosi Stock Tracker says a Senate vote to end the Iran war failed again, 48 to 51, and that Sen. John Fetterman was the lone Democrat blocking it. Not checked here.

Tesla says FSD v15 is starting to roll out, and lists a claim of 25x better handling of safety critical cases, a live visualization called Reality View, and slowing for speed cameras. Tesla's claims; not checked here.

The Lean FRO and Mathlib Initiative say they have verified a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis that Levent Alpöge released on November 20 as a Lean library of 17 million lines of code. Not checked here.
PETA posts "Here’s an idea: don’t eat turkey for Thanksgiving this year."

Mario Nawfal posts that Iran says its Revolutionary Guard hit two US Patriot radars at bases in Bahrain, while Bahrain says a civilian industrial site burned. The post says the two accounts do not match. Not checked here.
Reuters reports that a town in southern Brazil has been left reeling by a supercell storm.
Osint613 reports that at least three people have died and 39 are missing after a fire at a candy factory in Serang, Indonesia, and that search and rescue is ongoing. Not checked here.
